# Emmeline Drew

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Emmeline Drew prioritizes finding a suitable man to marry, acknowledging that an unattached single man is a better prospect than a widower with dependents despite the appeal of a parsonage. Known to lack drive, she approaches her prospects pragmatically, choosing to reconsider an elderly unmarried man from [Kettlebridge](../codex/places.md#kettlebridge) whom she had previously dismissed.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P40](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0040), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P4](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P5](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0005)_
